q: Identify the correct passive form of `He is going to open a shop.’
o: He is being gone to open a shop
A shop is being gone opened by him
A shop will be opened by him
A shop is going to be opened by him
e: Be going to কাঠামোর passive হয় be going to be + past participle। He is going to open a shop বাক্যে object a shop নতুন subject হয়, আর verb হয় is going to be opened। তাই A shop is going to be opened by him। Will be opened ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝালেও মূল বাক্যের is going to কাঠামো বদলে দেয়, তাই তা সঠিক রূপান্তর নয়।

q: Change the voice : ‘Who is calling me?”
o: By whom am I called?
By whom I am called?
By whom am I being called?
Whom am I called by?
e: ‘Who is calling me?’ বাক্যের passive রূপ ‘By whom am I being called?’ বাক্যটি present continuous, তাই passive-এ am/is/are + being + past participle বসে। who passive-এ by whom হয়, আর প্রশ্নবোধক হওয়ায় am কর্তা I-এর আগে বসে।

q: Identify the correct passive form: 'I heard her sing.'
o: She was heard sing by me.
She was heard to be sung by me.
She was heard sung by me.
She was heard to sing by me.
e: Active voice-এ hear, see, make, let ইত্যাদি verb-এর পরে to ছাড়া infinitive (bare infinitive) বসে: I heard her sing। কিন্তু passive করলে সেই to ফিরে আসে: She was heard to sing by me। একই নিয়মে They made him work > He was made to work। ‘to be sung’ গানের passive হতো, মানুষের নয়, আর ‘sung’ বা ‘sing’ to ছাড়া passive-এ বসে না।

q: The correct passive form of ”You must shut these doors” is - -
o: These must be shut doors
Shut the doors you must
Shut must be the doors
These doors must be shut
e: বাক্যে must, can, may, will-এর মতো modal verb থাকলে passive হয় এই কাঠামোয়: object + modal + be + past participle। ‘You must shut these doors’ বাক্যে object ‘these doors’, modal ‘must’, আর verb ‘shut’, যার past participle-ও shut। তাই passive দাঁড়ায়: These doors must be shut। ‘by you’ সাধারণত বাদ দেওয়া হয়। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে শব্দের ক্রম এলোমেলো, তাই সেগুলো ব্যাকরণগতভাবে ভুল।

q: Change the voice: ‘Nobody trusts a traitor.’
o: A traitor is trusted..
A traitor should not be trusted.
Everybody hates a traitor.
A traitor is not trusted by anybody.
e: Active voice-এ subject nobody, no one বা none হলে passive-এ ‘not … by anybody’ রূপ হয়। ‘Nobody trusts a traitor’ → object a traitor সামনে, verb present tense-এ is trusted, আর nobody বদলে not … by anybody; তাই A traitor is not trusted by anybody। ‘A traitor is trusted’ অর্থ উল্টে দেয়, ‘should not be trusted’ modal বদলায়, আর ‘Everybody hates a traitor’ ভিন্ন বাক্য।

q: Identify the right passive voice of ”It is impossible to do this”.
o: Doing this is impossible
This is impossible to be done
This is must be done
This can’t be done
e: ‘It is impossible to do this’ বাক্যের শুদ্ধ passive রূপ ‘This can’t be done.’ বাক্যের অর্থ কাজটি করা সম্ভব নয়; passive-এ this কর্তা হয়ে বসে আর অসম্ভবতা প্রকাশ পায় can’t be + past participle দিয়ে। ‘This is impossible to be done’ প্রচলিত শুদ্ধ গঠন নয়।

q: Identify the correct passive form: ‘Do not close the door.’
o: Let not the door close.
Let not the door be closed.
Let not the door close.
Let not door closed.
e: Imperative বাক্যের passive-এ Let দিয়ে শুরু হয়: Let + object + be + past participle। নিষেধাত্মক হলে Let-এর পরে not বসে (বা Don’t let … be …)। তাই Do not close the door → Let not the door be closed (বা Don’t let the door be closed)। ‘Let not the door close’-এ be আর past participle নেই, তাই এটি passive নয়; ‘Let not door closed’-এ article আর be দুটিই নেই।

q: The best passive form of the sentence: ‘We don’t like idle people’-
o: We are not liked by idle people.
Idle people are not like us.
Idle people are not liked by us.
Idle people are not of our liking.
e: ‘We don’t like idle people’-এর সঠিক passive রূপ ‘Idle people are not liked by us.’ Active থেকে passive করতে object (idle people) subject হয়, ক্রিয়া হয় be + past participle (are not liked), আর মূল subject by-এর পরে objective রূপে বসে (by us)। ‘We are not liked by idle people’ বাক্যে অর্থ উল্টে গেছে, কারণ সেখানে অলস লোকেরা আমাদের পছন্দ করে না।

q: Fill in the gap with the correct form of the verb: The police _____ informed yesterday.
o: is
are
was
were
e: ‘Police’ শব্দটি দেখতে একবচন হলেও অর্থে সবসময় বহুবচন, কারণ এতে পুলিশ বাহিনীর সদস্যদের বোঝায়; তাই এর verb বহুবচন: The police are, the police were। বাক্যে yesterday থাকায় অতীত কাল লাগবে, তাই The police were informed yesterday। একই রকম সবসময় বহুবচন collective noun: cattle, people, gentry। একজন সদস্য বোঝাতে বলা হয় a police officer বা policeman।

q: Give the correct passive form of ‘My teacher embodies all the good qualities’?
o: All the good qualities are embodied by my teacher.
All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.
All the good qualities are embodied to my teacher.
All the good qualities are embodied on my teacher.
e: শুদ্ধ passive রূপ ‘All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.’ embody মানে কোনো গুণ বা ভাব নিজের মধ্যে ধারণ করা; passive-এ গুণ যার মধ্যে মূর্ত হয়েছে তার আগে in বসে। by বসালে বোঝায় শিক্ষক গুণগুলোকে মূর্ত করার কাজটি করেছেন, যা প্রচলিত গঠন নয়।

q: Find out the correct passive form of the sentence ‘Who taught you French?’
o: By whom you were taught French?
By whom French was taught you?
French was taught you by whom?
By whom were you taught French?
e: প্রশ্নবোধক active বাক্যে subject Who হলে passive-এ By whom দিয়ে শুরু হয়। ‘Who taught you French?’-এ দুটি object: you (ব্যক্তি) আর French; ব্যক্তিবাচক object you-কে subject করা প্রচলিত। past tense আর প্রশ্নবাক্য বলে auxiliary were subject-এর আগে বসে, তারপর past participle taught: By whom were you taught French? প্রথম বিকল্পে were আর you-এর ক্রম প্রশ্নের মতো নয়, আর অন্যগুলোর গঠনও অপ্রচলিত।

q: The passive form of the sentence ‘some children were helping the wounded man’-
o: The wounded man was helped by some children
The wounded man was helping some children
The wounded man was being helped by some children
The wounded man was to be helped by some children
e: Some children were helping the wounded man বাক্যটি past continuous tense-এ। এই কালের passive গঠন: object + was/were being + past participle + by + subject। Object the wounded man একবচন, তাই was being helped: The wounded man was being helped by some children। Was helped হলো past indefinite-এর passive, আর was helping active গঠন, তাই অর্থ বদলে যায়।

q: Identify the correct passive form of the sentence below : ‘Do you Know them’?
o: Are they known by you?
Would they be known by you?
Are they known with you?
Are they known to you?
e: ‘Do you know them?’-এর passive ‘Are they known to you?’ know ক্রিয়ার passive-এ সাধারণত by-এর বদলে to বসে, যেমন ‘He is known to all.’ প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্য বলে auxiliary are শুরুতে বসেছে, আর them বদলে they হয়েছে।

q: The correct passive of ‘Sheila was writing a letter’ is –
o: A letter was writing by sheila.
A letter was being writing by sheila
A letter was being written by sheila
A letter was been written by sheila
e: ‘Sheila was writing a letter’ বাক্যের verb ‘was writing’ past continuous। Past continuous-এর passive গঠন: was/were + being + past participle। active-এর object ‘a letter’ একবচন, তাই was; write-এর past participle written; আর subject Sheila বসে by-এর পরে। ফলে A letter was being written by Sheila। ‘was writing’ active রূপই থেকে গেছে, ‘being writing’-এ past participle নেই, আর ‘was been written’ গঠন ব্যাকরণে নেই (been বসে have/has/had-এর পরে)। নামের প্রথম অক্ষর বড় হাতে লেখা উচিত: Sheila।

q: In each of the following questions, a sentence has been given in Active (or Passive) voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive (or Active) voice : I know him.
o: He is known by me.
He was known to me.
He has been known by me.
He is known to me.
e: ‘I know him’-এর passive ‘He is known to me.’ know ক্রিয়ার passive-এ by-এর বদলে সাধারণত to বসে, যেমন ‘He is known to everyone.’ মূল বাক্য present simple-এ থাকায় passive-এও is known হবে; ‘was known’ বা ‘has been known’ কাল বদলে দেয়।

q: The passive form of the sentence, "Who did the work?" is -
o: By whom the work was done?
Whom had the work done by?
By whom was the work done?
Who was the work done?
e:
‘Who did the work?’ বাক্যে Who কর্তা, the work কর্ম। Passive করার নিয়ম:
Who > By whom (বাক্যের শুরুতে)
কর্ম the work subject হয়
Past tense, তাই was + past participle done
প্রশ্নের ক্রমে auxiliary (was) subject-এর আগে বসে
ফল: By whom was the work done? ক বিকল্পে auxiliary আগে বসেনি, তাই প্রশ্নবাচক ক্রম ভেঙেছে।

q: People always remember patriots. Which of the following is the best passive form of the above sentence?
o: The patriots will always be remembered by people
The patriots are always being remembered
People are always remembered by The patriots
The patriots are always remembered
e: সবচেয়ে ভালো passive রূপ ‘The patriots are always remembered.’ Active বাক্যের object patriots এখানে subject হয়েছে, আর simple present বলে verb হয়েছে are remembered। ‘People’ সাধারণ কর্তা হওয়ায় passive বাক্যে by people বাদ দেওয়াই রীতি। will be remembered রাখলে কাল বদলে যায়, তাই তা ঠিক নয়।

q: Identify the passive form of the following sentence: "Who has broken this Jug?"
o: By whom has this Jug been broken?
By whom has this Jug broken?
By whom this Jug has been broken?
Whom has this Jug been broken?
e:
Who দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যকে passive করতে হলে কর্তার স্থানে 'By whom' বসিয়ে বাক্য শুরু করতে হয়। বাক্যটি Present Perfect Tense-এ আছে, আর এই tense-এর passive গঠন হলো has/have been + past participle। Break-এর past participle হলো broken। তাই রূপান্তরিত বাক্যটি হবে By whom has this jug been broken? অন্য বিকল্পগুলোতে been বাদ গেছে বা শব্দের ক্রম ঠিক নেই।
উদাহরণ:
Who has done this? এর passive হলো By whom has this been done?

q: 'The villagers believed that he was an honest leader.' Passive form of this sentence is:
o: He was believed to be an honest leader
He was believed to have been an honest leader
He has been believed to be an honest leader
He was believed he was an honest leader
e: ‘People believe/believed that…’ ধরনের বাক্যের passive দুভাবে হয়: It was believed that he was an honest leader, অথবা that-clause-এর subject সামনে এনে He was believed to be an honest leader। দুটি ক্রিয়া একই সময়ের (believed ও was), তাই simple infinitive ‘to be’ বসে। ‘to have been’ বসে যখন that-clause-এর ঘটনা আগের সময়ের হয়। গ-তে tense বদলে গেছে, আর ঘ ব্যাকরণগতভাবে ভুল গঠন।

q: Find out the active form of the sentence: “By whom can our country be saved?”
o: Who can save our country?
Our country has been saved by who?
Who save our country?
Who will save our country?
e: প্রশ্নবোধক passive বাক্য ‘By whom’ দিয়ে শুরু হলে active-এ শুরুতে Who বসে। এখানে modal verb can অপরিবর্তিত থাকে, be saved ভেঙে মূল verb save হয়, আর our country object হিসেবে পরে বসে। তাই By whom can our country be saved? → Who can save our country? Will বসালে tense বদলে যায়, আর ‘Who save’ বাক্যে modal বাদ পড়েছে।

q: She played on the flute. Passive form is -
o: The flute was played by her.
The flute was played on by her.
The flute was played to her.
The flute was being played by her.
e: Play on এমন একটি prepositional verb, যেখানে verb-এর সঙ্গে preposition একসঙ্গে অর্থ প্রকাশ করে। Passive করার সময় preposition ক্রিয়ার সঙ্গেই থেকে যায়। তাই 'She played on the flute' হয়ে যায় 'The flute was played on by her'। বাক্যটি Past Indefinite Tense-এ আছে, তাই passive-এ was + past participle বসেছে। Was being played হতো Past Continuous-এর ক্ষেত্রে।

q: Choose the correct from (passive) of__ `Who will do the work?’
o: Who will be done the work?
Who will done the work?
By whom will the work be done?
Whom will the work be done?
e: Active বাক্যের প্রশ্নসূচক ‘Who’ কর্তা হলে passive-এ তা ‘By whom’ হয়ে বাক্যের শুরুতে আসে। Object ‘the work’ নতুন subject হয়, আর future tense-এর passive গঠন will be + past participle; প্রশ্নসূচক বাক্যে will বসে subject-এর আগে। তাই By whom will the work be done? ‘Who will be done’ আর ‘Who will done’ গঠনে কর্ম ও কর্তার ভূমিকা উল্টে গেছে, আর ‘Whom will the work be done?’-এ by বাদ পড়েছে।

q: “Who planted this tree here?” The correct passive voice of this sentence is-
o: By whom was the tree planted here?
Who the tree had been planted hereby?
The tree was planted here by whom?
By whom had the tree been planted here?
e:
Active voice-এর বাক্যটি ‘Who planted this tree here?’। Who দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নকে Passive করতে ‘By whom’ দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। মূল বাক্য Past indefinite, তাই Passive-এ ‘was + past participle’ বসে। অতএব সঠিক Passive: By whom was the tree planted here?
উদাহরণ: Who wrote this letter? → By whom was this letter written?
